title: Mixed Event — Secret Operation Valentine's Day

meta.Outline: With Valentine's Day just on the horizon, Airi is planning a surprise for everyone to show them her gratitude. She happens to meet Saki and Emu, who both had similar ideas, and they form a Secret Valentine's Day Alliance.

rows.Line: Lunch Break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... There's way less people here. This should be a good spot for me to sit and think.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It's about time I came up with a good Valentine's Day surprise.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Just giving out chocolates would be pretty bland too. What would be more fun and interesting...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not really sure...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Humhumhuuum♪
How can I make Valentine's Day with Ichi and the others fun...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I tried surprising them with chocolates from that really famous shop last time, but some of us ended up getting the same thing...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I've gotta find a way to make sure my plan succeeds this year!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But how...? What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Something original...
Something that no one else would think of...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh...
It's almost Valentine's Day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We did a really amazing show last year, which was super duper fun♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Maybe I can ask Nene and the others to help out with another one this year☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I kinda want to surprise them and put big smiles on their faces...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know☆ What if I made some special and wonderhoy sweets that can make anyone smile?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Like shiny star cookies or chocolate robots that go cling-clang...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I could even make a show stage using them☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But how would I actually do that?
I'd have to melt a lot of chocolate, cool them using a really big refrigerator and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Chocolates? Chocolate-flavored sweets? Which would be better...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Saki
rows.Line: Owwy!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A-Are you two alright?!
That was a pretty nasty collision...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A-Airi!
I'm okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I apologize for bumping into you like that. I was thinking about something and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm sorry too!
I was looking elsewhere and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: H-Huh?! Saki, it's you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Emu!
I'm so sorry! Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup! I'm more than okay!
Thank goodness you weren't hurt either, Saki♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad it wasn't anything serious.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! Thank you very much for your concern!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? I swear I've seen her before somewhere... But where...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is Airi Momoi the idol!
AKA Happy Everyday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
W-Wow! It's really Airi...!
You used to do the lion dance every morning on that one show!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The Lion Mu-Mu-Music Battalion♪
Let's all do the carnivore ☆ dance!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you used to watch Morning Kids Station?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I really loved your lion dance!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Emu
rows.Line: Let's all do the carnivore dance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa! The real lion dance!
Just the way I remember it too!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. It's just my way of thanking you for being such a dedicated viewer. Let's dance together again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay☆
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're really the best, Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: By the way, you two both mentioned that you were thinking about something. Mind if I ask what?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, about that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's almost Valentine's Day, so I was trying to come up with a good way to surprise my friends...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?
You were trying to think of a surprise too, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Emu, you too?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, what a coincidence.
Hehe. I was trying to think of one just now as well!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-You too, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess it sorta just means everyone has the same thing on their minds this time of year.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, mind telling me what you've come up with so far? We can have a little discussion while we eat too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
L-Lunch with Airi...?!
Y-Yes, I'd love to!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, who do you two plan on surprising this year?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My goal's to knock the socks off of my bandmates and my brother with a really big surprise!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too! Me too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone who does shows with me, my big brothers, Mr. Mascot, Sakurako and Miku... I mean, all of my friends...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Th-That's a lot of people!
Also, shows...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! We do shows at Phoenix Wonderland's Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And my big brother's been performing in shows with Emu because they're in the same troupe!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Really? Small world, huh?
Wait, Phoenix Wonderland...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I saw that night show the last time I went!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You did?!
Everyone from the Wonder Stage and I actually came up with that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm so happy that you got to see it too, Airi☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
W-Wait, I'm so sorry!
I should be calling you by your last name!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. I don't really mind either way.
You can call me by my first name!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?!
Thank you, Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're so adorable.
I'm glad we met, Otori!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: C-Can I ask you to call me by my first name as well?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure. Emu, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! Yes, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu, I'm so jealous...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That goes for you too, Saki, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Airi..!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I promise to be your fan forever and ever and ever!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Haha. Thanks!
As your senior, I promise to look after you as well. I mean, you two are just too cute to ignore.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, it's clear that you both want to surprise the people who've been there for you... So what's giving you two such a headache?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see...
Saki, you're wondering how to actually surprise everyone, while Emu doesn't know how to make her gifts.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I wanna make some shiny star cookies, chocolate robots and a cake that looks like a show stage!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because I'm betting that everyone from the Wonder Stage is gonna smile from ear to ear if I make it right!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds like a wonderful gift!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...!
I'm just hoping that I can actually make it right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that does sound challenging...
Have you ever made anything like this before, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup, my big sis and I tried making some when I was little! But it didn't go very well...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We used all these yummy ingredients and even made it really colorful, but everything went all bo-boing for some reason once we were finished.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think I get the gist of what you're trying to say...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Sob*
What if I'm just not cut out for making my own chocolates?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
It might not have gone well back then, but I'm sure you'll succeed if you try now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, Emu!
Why don't we try making some together?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You and me, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup. Your story convinced me that I should bake some homemade chocolates for Ichi and the others too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm not sure how well that's gonna go...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Their friends must mean so much to them...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (As an idol, as well as their senior, I can't just sit idly by...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Saki, Emu, mind if I joined you on your culinary quest...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-You'll help us, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course. I've never made anything that big before, but we can use what I've made in the past as a reference.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This'll be perfect too since I was also thinking about doing something for everyone in MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay!
Thank you so much, Airi!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I have a feeling we can make anything as long as we have you on our side!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Then, we're in agreement.
This will be our Secret Valentine's Day Alliance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
A secret alliance...!
Hehe. I can't wait to see what we end up making.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Me neither!
Let's bake something that'll really knock everyone's socks off!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, let's make it so our Valentine's Day surprise becomes a huge success!
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Minori, keep up until the end!
One, two, three, pose!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Some parts still need improving, but it's starting to really take shape now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. We're moving much more in sync, so we should be able to move on to a new part soon.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! I'm gonna keep trying more and more to make sure we can!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You're just a ball of excitement, aren't you, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, let's aim to completely master this song during practice tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I think I mentioned this earlier, but I'm gonna be busy tomorrow and won't be able to make it to practice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Ah, okay.
In that case, why don't we just review what we did today during tomorrow's practice?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll make sure to get it so down that even you won't believe how good I've become, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll be looking forward to seeing that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But you hardly ever take days off, Airi.
Are you going shopping with your family?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Not quite with my family...
But I am going shopping.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Teaching Saki and Emu how to bake everything will probably end up taking the whole day.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But this is Valentine's Day we're talking about. We've gotta put our best foot forward to make sure our surprise succeeds!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nice work today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm exhausted... We did so much.
I'm drenched in sweat even though it's winter.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's proof that you really put in the work. However, sweat can also feel doubly cold this time of year, so try to also be mindful of that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we wouldn't want you to catch a cold as a result. You should find a way to warm back up sooner rather than later.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
Thanks for the advice, you two!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, why don't we all head home before it gets too cold?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I promised that I'd go buy ingredients with them today and I'm not about to make them wait in the cold.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, that reminds me...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I heard that the Japanese confectionary shop at the mall is selling these special sweets only for the next two days.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?! Special sweets...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! How about we head over to try some together?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, hang on...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry, I'm busy right after this too.
You guys go have fun without me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see. That's too bad...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sometimes, life just happens.
Also, we can always go again another time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, thanks!
I'd like that as well!
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...
Ichika, Honami, you've both improved quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Honami & Ichika
rows.Line: Yay...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you seem to be having trouble getting into this song's rhythm, Saki. Is there something on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What? Is there something bothering you, Saki...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
N-No, nothing at all!
This show I really like was on last night and I sorta stayed up a little too late...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I see.
Just make sure to get enough sleep tonight, alright?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I will! And thanks for looking out for me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Geez, Shiho's way too sharp...
I need to settle down before they find out...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm really excited about getting to shop for ingredients with Airi and Emu later, but...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Alright, just calm down... Focus!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shiho!
I promise to be more careful, so can we give it another try?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sure.
Count us in, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, here we go.
One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Great work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was awesome!
But I need to get going now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, also! I'm pretty sure I mentioned this before, but I'm busy tomorrow and won't be able to make it to practice!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right, you did mention that. Is something special happening?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! I, uh... Yeah, I'm going out with my family! There's this place Tsukasa said he wants to visit!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds nice.
I'm sure it'll be different but fun if it's somewhere Tsukasa wants to go.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to hear about what you do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Sorry, you guys...!
I absolutely promise to make sure your surprise is a good one...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Anyway, I should get going!
Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, bye bye. Stay safe.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
It seemed like she was in a hurry...
I forget, does Saki have work today?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I don't think so...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (What could be going on?)
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(After practice, it's shopping time...!
I can't wait! I can't wait! I can't wait!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Valentine, Valentine♪ Surprise♪
It's gonna be really wonderhoy...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, what are we gonna do for our next show? I feel like we should start building our repertoire as park ambassadors, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our current show will be coming to a close in due time, so I do agree that it is about time we started discussing ideas...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Indeed.
Then, why don't we begin right now?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How does that sound, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, uh...! A gingerbread house...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A gingerbread house...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh!? I just, um...!
I thought a story with a gingerbread house in it would be nice!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But what do you mean by a gingerbread house...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
I mean... A cute and sweet one, you know...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So a really sweet gingerbread house...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Um, well...!
It'd be a surprise... Wait, no! S-Suspenseful!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
A surprise...? Ohh...
Hehe. Now I get it...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So that's it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm?
I'm not sure I completely understand, but it sounds like a comedy that involves the family that lives there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's it!
It'll be hilariously sweet and really fun...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Then why don't we do a sweet show for a change next time?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?! Uhh...
S-Sure...? I guess... Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm?
I still have no idea what's going on...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyway, that should be enough!
Good practice today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We're done? Like, really done?
If we are, there's somewhere I need to be!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Bye, you guys! See you later!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Honestly, what's going on with her today?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seemed pretty normal to me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll be rewarded if you wait patiently.
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They said that they'll be waiting in the mall... This way! Okay, they should be... Aha!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey!
Saki! Airi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu! There you are!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Glad you made it!
Let this gathering of the Secret Valentine's Day Alliance commence.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get shopping for ingredients, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah♪
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Do you two already know what you're gonna make?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm all set!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me too!
I came up with a wonderhoy idea!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Great!
Let's start finding what we'll need!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll be making everything tomorrow, so make sure not to forget anything, alright?

rows.Speaker: Saki & Emu
rows.Line: Okay!
Confectionary Corner

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Everything's so sparkly!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This looks like the section for sugary toppings. Hey, they have ones that look like hearts and gems!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, there's lots and lots of chocolate over here! They even have a chocolate spray!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're like kids in a toy store.
FYI, as colorful as everything here is, it's all edible!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's sooo cool!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, if we put all these on top of our chocolates, we could make them look like little toy boxes! Wouldn't that be super cute?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I like your idea, but that might be going a bit overboard.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Look, they even have a chocolate pen!
You can draw whatever you want with it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're right!
I wanna try drawing Phenny with it☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They have them in all sorts of colors too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But these are a lot harder to use than you might imagine, so just keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that does seem really hard.
It's probably nothing like writing or drawing with a real pen...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But drawing on hard surfaces, like cookies, macarons or mini chocolate bars, isn't as challenging, so you could do some illustrations for those.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. All you have to do is take whatever picture you want to draw, sandwich it between some parchment paper, and trace and color on top of it using these chocolate pens.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll get the hang of it with a little practice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, I can do that!
Let's get all of these!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, these silvery gem things look really nice too. They're so pretty and sparkly...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whatever we make, these will make them even shinier, so let's get a bunch of these too...!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, hold on... All of these...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, hold your horses...
All this stuff's gonna make your sweets rock hard!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Rock hard?!
Not fluffy, sweet and shiny...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They'll be shiny but... Well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Listen, Emu...
This stuff's all nice and sparkly, but also hard and crunchy...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A little bit on a cake is sort of nice, but imagine every mouthful being filled with this stuff. What do you think will happen to everyone's teeth...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I-It'll make their teeth crumble to bits...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's going a bit too far...
But my point is that less is more!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I understand!
I promise to not put everyone's teeth in harm's way!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I might avoid getting too many of these.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, why don't we see what's over in that corner next?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, that looks like everything we'll need for making chocolates!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was so much fun! We even got some adorable toppings and tracing paper!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I can't wait to start☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That just leaves...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that smells nice♪
I think it's coming from the Japanese confectionary shop next door!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right! It's like it's calling out to us♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The Japanese confectionary shop?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku mentioned something about going there with the others today...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I just got an amazing idea!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How wonderhoy would it be to find manju hiding inside a cake☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: M-Manju?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, that would be a pretty big surprise...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
See what I mean☆
I'm gonna go buy some right now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
W-Wait, no...
Geez, she's quick!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm going after her.
Mind watching our baskets while I do, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Okay!
